The '''DynaCorp refinery''' was located on [[Grande Hyet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]] was destroyed in a [[Terrorist attacks on Esseles|terrorist attack]] by the [[Faceless]], causing [[DynaCorp]]'s stock to plummet.
